hero.tagline: TODO ig: Death is not the end.
hero.body: TODO ig: Summoned into the realm of Ogbun'abali, the Igbo deity of punishment and games, champions from the living world are forced to compete in a divine spectacle where survival is entertainment and power is earned through trial.
hero.aside: TODO ig: Fight through relentless dungeons. Master your chi. Challenge rival ascendants. Rise through the ranks and earn your place among the gods.

story.title: TODO ig: SOMA WAS NEVER MEANT TO BECOME A HERO
story.body1: TODO ig: Soma was an ordinary youth corps member whose life ended during a violent ambush.
story.body2: TODO ig: Caught between life and death, he was offered a second chance by Ogbun'abali, the god of punishment and games. Resurrected with awakened chi abilities, Soma is thrust into a world where gods, spirits, and hidden forces shape the fate of nations.
story.aside: TODO ig: Now summoned to the Tournament of the Gods, he must prove himself worthy of ascension while uncovering truths that were never meant to be revealed.

twoPaths.title: TODO ig: ONE ASCENSION.
twoPaths.body: TODO ig: The journey to greatness follows two interconnected paths.
twoPaths.trialsBody: TODO ig: Fight through wave-based dungeons filled with mythological enemies and powerful bosses. Earn rewards, unlock abilities, and climb through twelve divine ranks.
twoPaths.arenaBody: TODO ig: Take your customized champion into fast-paced 1v1 and 2v2 PvP battles. Master your skills, outplay your opponents, and compete for a place on the leaderboards.
